story: Once upon a time, there lived a crane near a pond. The crane had built its nest on a tree and lived happily. But there was a snake living in a hole near the tree. Every time the crane laid eggs, the snake would eat them. The crane became very sad. One day, a wise crab said, “I have an idea. Bring some fish and drop them along the path to a mongoose’s hole.” The crane followed the advice. The mongoose came out, followed the trail of fish, and soon found the snake. It fought with the snake and killed it. The crane felt happy. But then, the mongoose climbed the tree and ate the crane’s eggs too. The crane realized its mistake.
